info.title: Fawaterak API
info.description:
Public API transactions (API v3), enables you to accept online payments through a unified and flexible integration platform.

Integration types:
- API integration - Server to Server integration
- Iframe integation - Host Fawaterk transaction link at your Website.
- Mobile integration - Native apps via OAuth + TR APIs

**Authentication overview**
- **OAuth client credentials** — machine-to-machine (`POST /oauth/token` with `grant_type=client_credentials` → Bearer on `/api/v3/*` transaction and payment-method endpoints).
- **OAuth refresh token** — renew an access token with `POST /oauth/token` and `grant_type=refresh_token` when your integration stores a refresh token from the initial token response.
- **Domain hash** — browser iframe without a merchant backend (`FAWATERAK-HASH-KEY` + `FAWATERAK-DOMAIN`; see **Iframe integration**).

servers.description: Your server — Fawaterak POSTs webhooks to URLs you configure in the dashboard or per-transaction `redirectionUrls`.

tags.name: Get started
tags.description: To get started you need to create a business account from here appUrl/regsiter. To complete your integrations setup, login to your created account > Integrations tab: - OAuth client credentials (API) - to create client id and secret. - Integrations - to setup your redirection URLs / Iframe domains / Webhook URLs (paid, failed, cancel, refund).

tags.name: Auth token
tags.description:
Obtain and renew Bearer access tokens for `/api/v3/*` OAuth-protected endpoints (transactions, refunds, e-invoicing).

| Step | Endpoint | `grant_type` | Purpose |
|------|----------|--------------|--------|
| **1** | `POST /oauth/token` | `client_credentials` | Exchange client ID + secret for an access token (and refresh token when enabled) |
| **2** | `POST /oauth/token` | `refresh_token` | Renew the access token using a stored refresh token + client ID + secret |

Create OAuth credentials in the vendor dashboard → **Integrations → OAuth client credentials**.

tags.name: Transactions overview
tags.description:
Transactions let you process a single **one-time payment** with a clear lifecycle status: **success**, **fail**, or **pending**.

There are two ways to create a transaction:

**1. Hosted checkout (redirection link)** — Do **not** send `payment_method_id`. The API creates a transaction link and returns a hosted checkout URL in `data.url`. Redirect the customer to it (or open it inside an iframe / WebView); the customer selects a payment method and pays on the Fawaterak-hosted page. This is a single payment attempt — the link is not meant to be reused for multiple tries.

**2. Direct payment** — Send `payment_method_id` (from `GET /api/v3/getTrPaymentmethods`). The API initiates payment immediately with that specific method and returns the provider response in `data.payment_data` (for example a Fawry reference code, a Meeza wallet request, or a card 3-D Secure redirect).

| Mode | Send `payment_method_id`? | Use from response |
|------|---------------------------|-------------------|
| Hosted checkout | No | `data.url` |
| Direct payment | Yes | `data.payment_data` |

Authenticate every call with `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` from `POST /oauth/token`. Always confirm the **final paid status from your webhook**, not only from the customer redirect.

tags.name: Iframe integration
tags.description:
Embed Fawaterak checkout on your website with **fawaterkPlugin.js** (`/fawaterkPlugin/fawaterkPlugin.js`). Both flows open the same hosted checkout page (`/transactions/{intent_key}`) inside an iframe. --- ## Integration types | You have | Approach | Auth | |----------|----------|------| | **Frontend** — HTML/JavaScript only, no server | Plugin creates the session from the browser via domain hash | Domain HMAC (`FAWATERAK-HASH-KEY` + `FAWATERAK-DOMAIN`) | | **Backend** — a server that can call APIs securely (recommended) | Server creates the checkout session; the page only receives a checkout URL | OAuth client credentials | **Prerequisite (both types):** Register your site domain under **Integrations → iframe domains** in the vendor dashboard. --- ## Frontend integration (browser-only) Use when you cannot call Fawaterak APIs from a server. **Do not embed your API key in the page** — use a domain-bound hash key instead. 1. **Register your domain** — Vendor dashboard → **Integrations → iframe domains** (e.g. `https://shop.example.com`). 2. **Compute the hash key** — Prefer a small server script or build step (not hand-calculated in production): ``` ProviderKey = "FAWATERAK.{your_vendor_id}" StringToSign = "Domain={your_domain}&ProviderKey={ProviderKey}" hashKey = HMAC-SHA256(StringToSign, your_vendor_api_key) ``` Send `hashKey` as header `FAWATERAK-HASH-KEY` and your domain as `FAWATERAK-DOMAIN`. The hash only works from registered domains. 3. **Add the plugin** — Pass `hashKey` and `requestBody` (same cart fields as `createTransaction`). The plugin initializes the session automatically, then loads checkout in the iframe: ```html
``` `list_style` controls payment-method layout on the hosted checkout page: `"h"` (default) horizontal, `"v"` vertical. **Frontend limitations:** A user could change `cartTotal` in the browser before payment. Always verify the paid amount in your **webhook** and compare it to your order total. --- ## Backend integration Your server creates the payment session. The customer's browser never receives OAuth credentials or your API key. 1. **Get OAuth credentials** — Vendor dashboard → **Integrations → OAuth client credentials**. Create a client and note the client ID, client secret, and token URL (`POST /oauth/token`). 2. **Create a payment session (server-side)** — Obtain an access token (client credentials grant), then call `POST /api/v3/createTransaction` with `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` and your cart JSON. Include `list_style` when you want a vertical payment-method list (`"v"`; default is `"h"`). Use `data.url` (or `data.short_url`) from the response as the checkout address. Example request body: ```json { "cartTotal": 150.00, "currency": "EGP", "list_style": "h", "customer": { "first_name": "Ahmed", "last_name": "Ali", "email": "ahmed@example.com", "phone": "01000000000" }, "cartItems": [ { "name": "Product A", "price": "150.00", "quantity": "1" } ], "redirectionUrls": { "successUrl": "https://yoursite.com/success", "failUrl": "https://yoursite.com/fail", "webhookUrl": "https://yoursite.com/webhooks/fawaterak_json" } } ``` 3. **Add the plugin to your page** — Render a fresh `intentUrl` per order from your server: ```html
``` Do not hard-code one checkout link for all orders unless the amount is fixed. --- ## After payment Configure **success**, **fail**, and **webhook** URLs (dashboard and/or `redirectionUrls` on each transaction). Mark orders as paid from **webhooks** — do not rely on the customer returning to the success page alone. See **Webhooks** for payload format, verification, and handling. | envType | Use | |---------|-----| | `live` | Production | | `test` | Staging / sandbox |

tags.name: Tokenization and recurring
tags.description:
Tokenization allows you to store card payment details in exchange for a token. The token replaces raw card data in later payment requests, so you can charge the saved card for tokenized or recurring payments without asking for the card details again.

---

## How it works

1. Call `POST /api/v2/createCardTokenScreen` to generate a Fawaterak-hosted card collection URL. Open the URL in an iframe or redirect the customer to it.
2. After the customer saves the card, Fawaterak creates the token and sends it to your tokenization webhook.
3. Use the returned `customerCardToken` / token later with `POST /api/v2/createTokenizationPayRequest`.

## Payment types

- **Tokenization payment** — send `tokenAction: "tokenization"`; response contains `redirectTo` for the 3DS/authentication flow.
- **Recurring payment** — do **not** send `tokenAction`; response contains `transaction_id` after successful processing.

The generated card screen link expires after about **10 minutes**. If the screen expires or saving the card fails, the link cannot be reused.

---

## Created token webhook

When a token is created, your webhook receives data similar to:

```json
{
  "customerUniqueId": "222111333",
  "customerCard": "512345xxxxxx0008",
  "customerCardToken": "9731673377207107",
  "hashKey": "f59665d4077...ea2",
  "cardBrand": "MASTERCARD",
  "cardTokenUniqueId": "2345"
}
```

Validate `hashKey` with HMAC SHA256 using your vendor API key:

```php
$queryParam = "customerUniqueId=XYZ&customerCardToken=XYZ";
$hash = hash_hmac('sha256', $queryParam, 'FAWATERAK_VENDOR_KEY', false);
```

These are legacy v2 endpoints protected by `ValidateVendorToken`. Send `Authorization: Bearer {vendor_api_key}` and `Content-Type: application/json`.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Fawaterak sends **server-to-server POST** notifications to **your** endpoints. These are not Fawaterak API routes — implement the handlers on your server and register the URLs in the vendor dashboard (**Integrations**) or per transaction via `redirectionUrls`.

| Webhook | When | Configure URL |
|---------|------|----------------|
| **Paid / pending** | Payment succeeds or is pending (Fawry, Aman, …) | `webhookUrl` (per transaction) or dashboard **Webhook** |
| **Failed** | Card/gateway payment fails | Dashboard **Failed webhook** |
| **Cancel** | Reference expires or is canceled (Aman, Masary, Meeza, …) | Dashboard **Cancellation webhook** |
| **Refund** | Refund request is approved | Dashboard **Refund webhook** |

Use **`_json`** in the URL path for **paid** and **failed** webhooks to receive `application/json`; otherwise the body is `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. **Cancel** and **refund** webhooks are always JSON.

See the **POST** operations below for request and response examples. Verify `transactionHashKey` on paid webhooks; verify `hashKey` on failed and cancel webhooks.

tags.name: E-Commerce Plugins
tags.description:
We provide multiple ready-made plugins to accept Fawaterak payments on popular e-commerce platforms.

---

## Plugins

1. **WooCommerce** — [Download the plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/fawaterk-for-woocommerce/)
2. **ExpandCart** — Through our executive partnership with ExpandCart you can create your own store and accept online payments through **Expand Pay**, powered by Fawaterak.
3. **OpenCart** — Download from the official OpenCart marketplace: [click here](https://www.opencart.com/index.php?route=marketplace/extension/info&extension_id=43750&filter_search=fawaterk&filter_category_id=3)
4. **Shopify (redirect — all payment methods)** — Log in to **Shopify** and **Fawaterak** in separate tabs, then install: [click here](https://apps.shopify.com/fawaterak)
5. **Shopify (embedded card payment only)** — Log in to **Shopify** and **Fawaterak** in separate tabs, then install: [click here](https://apps.shopify.com/fawaterak-credit-card)
6. **WHMCS** — [Download the plugin](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/111-ZMLJ3LxFMkusaKkXga475E2fUYtOF?usp=sharing)
7. **CS-Cart** — [Download the plugin](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BCGhzsrMbrMpWB4XY7t0gGniuoy7bj62?usp=sharing)
8. **Magento** — [Download the plugin](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VhjQfDZ3WbjMZjX8NO4HYQAfEyLLlhOv?usp=sharing)

---

## Important note (Cloudflare)

If you use **Cloudflare** with the WooCommerce plugin, add a **path-based WAF skip rule** so Fawaterak webhooks are not blocked:

**Security → WAF → Custom Rules**

| Setting | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **IF** URI Path equals | `/wc-api/fawaterak_webhook_json` |
| **THEN** Skip | Browser Integrity Check, Bot Fight Mode, JS Challenge |

tags.name: Mobile integrations
tags.description:
Easy integration with your **mobile app** (React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Java, Swift) using **API v3** and **TR** (cache-based transactions).

---

## Overview

The mobile flow has two steps:

| Step | Endpoint | Purpose |
|------|----------|--------|
| **1** | `GET /api/v3/getTrPaymentmethods` | List enabled payment methods for your account |
| **2** | `POST /api/v3/createTransaction` | Create a TR intent and pay (direct-dispatch or hosted link) |

---

## Authentication

Use **OAuth client credentials** (not the legacy vendor API key):

1. Create credentials in the vendor dashboard → **Integrations → OAuth client credentials**.
2. Call `POST /oauth/token` to obtain a Bearer access token.
3. Send `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on all `/api/v3/*` mobile calls.

---

## How payment methods behave

| `redirect` value | Mobile handling |
|------------------|-----------------|
| `"true"` | **Link mode** — response includes `data.url`; open in a **WebView** / in-app browser |
| `"false"` | **Direct-dispatch** — provider reference or RTP returned synchronously (Fawry, Meeza, …) |

**Important:** Meeza (mobile wallets) is validated with **real payments** in production. Pass `mobileWalletNumber` when required.

Mark orders as paid from **webhooks** (`redirectionUrls.webhookUrl`) — see **Webhooks**.

Mobile — Process transaction
Refund APIs
tags.description:
Manage refund requests for paid transactions via **OAuth client credentials**.

**Legacy v2:** Existing integrations may continue using `/api/v2/refund/*` with the vendor API key (`ValidateVendorToken`). Those routes are unchanged.

**Flow (v3):**
1. `POST /api/v3/refund/refundTypes` — get `refund_type` keys (`0` = invoice, `1` = payment link transaction, `2` = collection link transaction).
2. `POST /api/v3/refund/refundReasons` — list allowed refund reasons.
3. `POST /api/v3/refund/create` — submit a refund using `refund_type` + `refund_id` (invoice id or payment-request transaction id).
4. `POST /api/v3/refund/index` / `GET /api/v3/refund/details/{id}` — list and inspect requests.
5. `POST /api/v3/refund/delete` — cancel a pending (non-approved) request.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` from `POST /oauth/token`.

tags.name: Payment operations
tags.description:
Capture or void card payments (auth-and-capture) via **OAuth client credentials**.

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|----------|--------|
| `POST /api/v3/payment/capture` | Capture (settle) an authorized hold — full or partial |
| `POST /api/v3/payment/void` | Void an **authorized** hold (not a captured payment) |

**Capture identity:** `type=transaction` uses `intent_key` from createTransaction / webhook / redirect; `type=invoice` uses `transaction_id` (invoice id).

**Void identity:** `type=transaction` uses `intent_key` from createTransaction / webhook / redirect; `type=invoice` uses `transaction_id` (invoice id).

**Responses** use `status`, `message`, and `data` (identity fields plus merchant `pay_load` from create).

**Legacy:** `/api/v2/bank/createCapture` and `/api/v2/bank/createVoid` remain for vendor-token clients and are unchanged.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` from `POST /oauth/token`.

tags.name: Overview
tags.description:
E-invoicing lets you create an invoice and share it with your customers via **email**, **SMS**, or **manually** (copy the payment link). The customer can pay the invoice at **any time within the due date** (if a due date is set), and can **try multiple payment methods** for the same invoice link until the payment succeeds.

Invoices are persisted in the `invoices` table with `create_source = API.v3.EI.IN` and return a hosted payment link (`/in/{invoice_key}`).

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` from `POST /oauth/token`.

tags.name: E-invoicing
tags.description:
Create and manage **e-invoices** via OAuth client credentials. Invoices are persisted in the `invoices` table with `create_source = API.v3.EI.IN`. Returns a hosted payment link (`/in/{invoice_key}`) for the customer to pay.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` from `POST /oauth/token`.

post.description:
Exchange the **client ID** and **client secret** (vendor dashboard → Integrations → OAuth client credentials) for a Bearer access token used on `/api/v3/*` OAuth-protected endpoints.

When refresh tokens are enabled for your OAuth client, the response also includes `refresh_token`. Store it securely and use **Refresh access token** to renew access without repeating the full client-credentials exchange.

Exchange a valid **refresh token** (from a previous `client_credentials` token response) for a new Bearer access token.

Send the same **client ID** and **client secret** that were used to obtain the refresh token. A new `refresh_token` is returned when token rotation is enabled — replace the stored value with the new one.

get.description:
Returns integration-enabled payment methods for the vendor linked to the OAuth client.

 **Important hint:** This API list the payment options has "Integration status" enabled in - Business settings > Payment method.

Call after `POST /oauth/token` with `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}`. Use each item's `payment_method_id` as `payment_method_id` when calling `createTransaction`.

| `redirect`    | Behavior |
|------------|----------|
| `"true"` | **Link mode** — customer completes payment on hosted checkout (`data.url` from createTransaction) |
| `"false"` | **Direct-dispatch** — provider reference or RTP returned synchronously from createTransaction |

post.description:
> **Transaction types:**
> - **Hosted checkout:** do **not** send `payment_method_id`. This creates a transaction link and returns a hosted checkout URL in `data.url`.
> - **Direct payment:** send `payment_method_id`. This initiates payment directly using that specific payment method and returns the method response in `data.payment_data`.

Creates a **TR** payment intent. No `transactions` row until the customer pays or **direct-dispatch** runs.

Use `payment_method_id` from `getTrPaymentmethods` only when you want to initiate payment with a specific payment method.

| Mode | When | Action |
|------|------|--------|
| **Hosted checkout** | No `payment_method_id` | Create a transaction link and redirect the customer to `data.url` hosted checkout. |
| **Direct payment** | `payment_method_id` is provided | Pay/initiate the transaction using that selected method and return `data.payment_data`. |

**Hosted checkout (default):** returns hosted URLs (`/transactions/{intent_key}`).

**Direct-dispatch:** when `payment_method_id` has `apiRedirect = "false"` and no `resource` / truthy `redirectOption`, returns provider response synchronously inside `data.payment_data`.

payment_method_id.description: Preselects method on hosted checkout; may trigger direct-dispatch when eligible.

cartTotal.description: Total transaction amount before optional shipping, tax, and discount adjustments.

currency.description: ISO currency code. `SAR` is stored as `SR`.

save_customer.description: When `true`, the customer is saved to your customers list (and linked to the transaction) at the time the transaction row is created. Defaults to `false` for transactions. When `true`, `customer.customer_unique_id` is required.

customer_unique_id.description: Customer id at your system. Required when `save_customer` is `true`.

cartItems.description: One or more cart items included in the transaction.

pay_load.description: Opaque merchant JSON payload stored as `pay_load` and returned in webhooks.

pendingUrl.description: Customer redirect when payment is pending (async methods).

backUrl.description: Customer redirect when they choose not to proceed with payment or need to go back to edit the order. Used as the hosted checkout back/cancel link.

webhookUrl.description: Server webhook URL for this transaction. Overrides the vendor dashboard default. Use `_json` in the path for JSON body delivery.

redirectionUrls.description: Customer redirect URLs, optional back/cancel URL, and optional per-transaction webhook URL.

sendEmail.description: When true, sends the hosted checkout link to the customer email when available.

sendSMS.description: When true, sends the hosted checkout link to the customer phone number when available and SMS sending is enabled.

due_date.description: Defaults to +2 days from request time.

redirectOption.description: When true, forces link mode even if direct-dispatch would otherwise apply.

authAndCapture.description: Enable auth-and-capture on supported card flows.

value.description: Percentage tax applied at TR creation.

taxData.description: Tax data applied at TR creation.

type.description: Discount type: percentage (`pcg`) or fixed amount (`literal`).

discountData.description: Discount data applied at TR creation.

list_style.description: Payment-method list layout on hosted checkout: `h` horizontal (default), `v` vertical.

lang.description: Appended as `?lg=` on returned URLs when provided.

200.description: Transaction link created. Response shape depends on whether `payment_method_id` is provided.

payment_data.description: Payment method response. Shape depends on the selected payment method.

referenceNumber.description: Payment reference code for the customer to pay at Fawry, Aman, or Masary.

systemReference.description: Meeza wallet system reference for the RTP request.

isoQr.description: ISO QR payload for wallet scan-to-pay.

post.description:
Fawaterak **POST**s to your **webhook URL** when a payment completes or is **pending** (async methods such as Fawry, Aman, Masary).

**Configure:** `redirectionUrls.webhookUrl` on `createTransaction` / iframe `requestBody`, or the default **Webhook** URL in Integrations.

**API payload:** `transaction_key` = transaction `intent_key`; `transaction_id` = `transactions.id`; `status` = `paid` or `pending`.

**Verify `transactionHashKey`:**
```
StringToSign = "TransactionId=" + transaction_id + "&TransactionKey=" + transaction_key + "&PaymentMethod=" + payment_method
expectedHash = HMAC-SHA256(StringToSign, your_vendor_api_key)
```

Legacy v2 TR payloads may also include `hashKey` signed with `InvoiceId` / `InvoiceKey` instead of `TransactionId` / `TransactionKey`.

Return **HTTP 200** promptly. Fulfill orders only when `status` is `paid`.

servers.description: Your webhook endpoint (example path — use your own URL)

application/x-www-form-urlencoded.description: Used when your webhook URL does **not** contain `_json` in the path.

200.description: Webhook accepted — your server should respond quickly

post.description:
Fawaterak **POST**s to your **Failed webhook** URL when a payment attempt fails (e.g. card declined, gateway error).

**Configure:** Integrations → **Failed webhook** (`failedWebhook`).

**API payload:** `transaction_key` = transaction `intent_key`; `transaction_id` = `transactions.id`.

**Verify `hashKey`:**
```
StringToSign = "TransactionId=" + transaction_id + "&TransactionKey=" + transaction_key + "&PaymentMethod=" + payment_method
expectedHash = HMAC-SHA256(StringToSign, your_vendor_api_key)
```
For IN (invoice) payloads, replace `TransactionId`/`TransactionKey` with `InvoiceId`/`InvoiceKey`.

Fawaterak **POST**s to your **Cancellation webhook** when a payment reference expires or is canceled (Aman, Masary, Meeza, and similar async references).

**Configure:** Integrations → **Cancellation webhook** (`cancellationWebhook`).

**Content-Type:** always `application/json`.

**Verify `hashKey`:**
```
StringToSign = "referenceId=" + referenceId + "&PaymentMethod=" + paymentMethod
expectedHash = HMAC-SHA256(StringToSign, your_vendor_api_key)
```

canceled.summary: Reference canceled by merchant or system

post.description:
Fawaterak **POST**s to your **Refund webhook** when a refund request is **approved**.

**Configure:** Integrations → **Refund webhook** (`refundWebhook`).

**Content-Type:** always `application/json`.

**Verify `hashKey`:**
```
StringToSign = "transactionId=" + transactionId + "&amount=" + amount + "&currency=" + currency
expectedHash = HMAC-SHA256(StringToSign, your_vendor_api_key)
```

oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Passport OAuth 2.0 for API v3. Obtain an access token with `grant_type=client_credentials`, then renew it with `grant_type=refresh_token` on the same `/oauth/token` URL. Use the access token as `Authorization: Bearer {token}` on OAuth-protected `/api/v3/*` endpoints.

vendorApiKeyBearer.description: Legacy vendor API key used by v2 endpoints with `ValidateVendorToken`. Send `Authorization: Bearer {vendor_api_key}` and `Content-Type: application/json`.

refresh_token.description: Present when refresh tokens are enabled for the OAuth client. Store securely and use with `grant_type=refresh_token` to obtain a new access token.
